feed.title: Ahmed Alhafiz Research Desk
feed.subtitle: Full English research editions with traceable evidence and disclosed review status.

entry.title: Teaching the Names and AI: What Counts as Understanding?
entry.summary: A bilingual dossier separating symbol use, relational structure, compositional generalization, grounding, causal world-model use, intention and responsibility, while treating consciousness as a separate unresolved question.

entry.title: Ratq, fatq, and the Big Bang: text, exegesis, evidence, and limits
entry.summary: A layered inquiry into Qur’an 21:30, classical exegesis, and hot Big Bang cosmology, separating text, observation, model, and metaphysical inference.

entry.title: Water, Civilization and Power: When Does Resource Governance Produce Justice—and When Does It Become Control?
entry.summary: A bilingual dossier building a six-layer chain from resource and infrastructure to data, allocation, accountability, maintenance, and resilience, tested against Ma’rib, Mesopotamia, Angkor, and contemporary water governance.

entry.title: When Fear Decides Before Diagnosis: How Uncertainty Becomes Authority and Coercion in Families
entry.summary: An evidence-led dossier on how an ambiguous symptom can move through family fear, premature certainty, authority transfer and consent erosion—and how a parallel-path safeguard preserves assessment, voice and voluntary spiritual support.
